text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Introducing a periodic consolidation/compression step for the stored fact set will mitigate the sharp QA accuracy drop observed when the memory exceeds ~40 items by reducing cross‑fact interference, leading to stable performance at larger memory sizes.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["562412ff","72ccf918"],"tags":["accuracy","consolidation","compression","interference","memory_scaling"]},{"statement":"The performance improvements reported for the 'rewrite' operation in the ICLR paper are likely driven by an implicit external‑memory paging mechanism similar to MemGPT’s virtual context management, rather than the rewrite semantics itself; therefore a rewrite‑vs‑append ablation must control for paging effects to isolate the true source of gain.","confidence":0.65,"support_ids":["3b78000a","a962f389"],"tags":["rewrite","append","memory_paging","MemGPT","ablation"]}]}
